claims.claim_text: The indexed Sam Berman is a high-confidence match to the OSS cartoonist and caricaturist described in two CIA histories.
claims.evidence_paraphrase: The exact private identifier links the index row to an Army entrant classified as a commercial artist; CIA independently names an OSS cartoonist or caricaturist Sam Berman, and the Smithsonian documents a prewar caricaturist by that name.
claims.identity_match_assessment: High confidence based on the exact private identifier, matching commercial-art occupation, two official OSS-role references, and a compatible prewar institutional record.
claims.temporal_assessment: The Army occupation is dated September 8, 1943; the Smithsonian item is dated 1934; neither source establishes the precise date of OSS entry.
claims.match_notes: Because the public CIA and Smithsonian records do not expose the index identifier, the broader biographical match remains high-confidence rather than confirmed. No employer is inferred.

research_attempts.query_text: Thomas Berletic: NARA index context and Army name check; CIA Reading Room; exact-name OSS variants; employment and occupation; institutional, newspaper, obituary, and archival searches.

research_attempts.research_notes: Accessible sources did not identify the indexed person beyond the name and file location.
research_attempts.next_action: Review Box 52 personnel file for identifiers and recruitment history.
